cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(nlp_robot_interfaces)

# Custom messages/actions must be generated by rosidl, which needs an ament_cmake
# package. That is why the interfaces live in their own small package and the
# Python code lives in nlp_robot.
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(builtin_interfaces REQUIRED)

rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
  "msg/DetectedObject.msg"
  "msg/DetectedObjectArray.msg"
  "action/ExecuteCommand.action"
  DEPENDENCIES std_msgs geometry_msgs builtin_interfaces
)

ament_export_dependencies(rosidl_default_runtime)
ament_package()
